review.recipe: Single pale cloudy gold Cameron's Kick in coupe, exactly three whole coffee beans on thin natural shake froth; no espresso colour, ice, citrus garnish.
review.personality: Worn closed pocket book and habitual frayed magenta scarf with small repaired pin imply a kept personal ritual, without cartoon insect. V2 groups them close and gives smaller serve.
review.world: Walnut historic reading-room bar, burgundy chair, one warm right practical lamp, neutral near-black left; no neon/magenta backdrop.
